summary_en: Shikoku Kasei Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 1.8 million shares (2.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥4.0 billion through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from mid-September through December 31, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Progress of Disclosure Items)
translation_en_brief: On September 9, 2026, Shikoku Kasei Holdings announced confirmation of the acquisition period for a previously authorized treasury stock repurchase program. The company will acquire up to 1.8 million shares (2.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥4.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from September 17, 2026 (the business day following the settlement date of a concurrent public offering announced on September 1) through December 31, 2026. The acquisition method is open market purchase, and the company notes that market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the program.
